headline: Nebius, an AI cloud company, has become the first customer of an AI gigafactory based in Rotterdam, Techzine Global reports.
score_reason: Pool score 6 lowered by 1: only the headline could be checked and no other outlet carries the story.
importance_line: It matters to European firms and public bodies that want AI computing power built in Europe, then to Nebius, but the size, owner, timing and terms of the deal are not known.
summary: Techzine Global reports that Nebius, a company that rents out AI computing power, is the first customer of an AI gigafactory based in Rotterdam.
notes: Headline only: Techzine page blocked (403) and no other outlet found. Nebius also appeared in our 11 Oct pool in a different story (court case in Independence).
